example_prompt: Verify a user's ID document (e.g. a Senegalese or Guinean IDENTITY_CARD or PASSPORT) with a selfie, using Smile ID's hosted Web SDK flow, and read the verdict from the webhook.

token.description: Short-lived v3 token from your backend.

product.description: 'doc_verification' per the Web SDK reference pages; the troubleshooting FAQ calls it a legacy v11 identifier and gives 'document_verification' (see gotchas).

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for the verification verdict.

consent_information.description: Pre-obtained consent; skips the consent screen. See below.

notice_language.description: optional, defaults to the UI language

user_details.description: Pre-supplied user details; skips the user-details form. See below.

email.description: at least one of email / phone_number

consent_region.description: `'eu'` or `'non-eu'` — overrides consent-checkbox region detection. See below.

id_selection.description: Constrain selectable countries/ID types, e.g. `{ NG: ['BVN', 'NIN'] }`.

partner_params.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata echoed back on the webhook.

translation.description: Language and string overrides — see [Theming and Customization](/developer-resources/sdks/web/web-sdk/theming-and-customization.md).

hide_attribution.description: Hide the "Powered by Smile ID" footer. Default `false`.

onResult.description: Callback (function) Recommended. Called with a `{status: 'success' | 'failure' | 'cancelled', ...}` result — see [Getting Result of a Verification](/developer-resources/sdks/web/web-sdk/getting-result-of-a-verification.md).

document_capture_modes.description: Which capture methods the document-capture screen offers: ['camera'] (camera only) or ['camera', 'upload'] (both). Defaults to both. Upload-only is not supported.

response_schema.description: Argument passed to the onResult callback — a success | failure | cancelled union. Every state also carries result.product.

product.description: undefined when cancelled before a product was chosen

value.description: success only — the endpoint's 202 Accepted body verbatim

gotchas: The docs conflict on the product identifier: the Web SDK reference pages use 'doc_verification', while the v12/v3 troubleshooting FAQ says 'doc_verification' is a legacy v11 identifier and gives 'document_verification' as the v12 one. The FAQ also says a token is product-specific and must match the product initialized in the SDK. Verify in sandbox before shipping.

The browser never sees the API key: your backend mints the token (generate_token) per session and returns it to the page. Load the SDK only from https://cdn.usesmileid.com/inline/v12/js/script.min.js — the embed is not published to npm.
partner_details is required with all five fields (partner_id, name, logo_url, policy_url, theme_color) — the SDK rejects the config at init if any is missing.

onResult 'success' only means the job was accepted (202); result.value is { job_id, user_id, status, message, created_at }. The verdict exists only on the webhook (webhook_verification_result) — never onboard a user from the browser callback.
id_type is optional for Document Verification: omit it and Smile ID classifies the document server-side. It does not use id_info. The countries/ID types offered come from list_supported_documents.
Serve the page over HTTPS (or localhost) and add allow="camera" to any wrapping iframe, or the browser refuses camera access.
environment must match the token: a sandbox token in 'production' (or the reverse) fails with 401 during the flow.
